title: Layla and the Borrowed Faces
logline: Layla wears a hundred masks until Aref asks to see the one beneath.
story: A hundred faces hung by the door, and Layla, for all of observer of unseen currents, wore a different one for every visitor. Then Aref, who was the knower, asked a single quiet question: which face do you wear when no one is watching? Layla had no answer, and that silence was more frightening than any crowd. So Layla began, slowly, to set the masks down one by one, and found beneath them not emptiness but a plain, unguarded face. It was the only face anyone had ever truly wanted to meet.
moral: The self you hide in order to be loved is the very self that love was looking for.
